query: INSERT INTO app_docs (id, application_id, slug, title, content, position, created_at, updated_at) SELECT u.id, $1, u.slug, u.title, u.content, u.position, $7, $7 FROM UNNEST($2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[], $6::int[]) AS u(id, slug, title, content, position) ON CONFLICT (application_id, slug) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, content = EXCLUDED.content, position = EXCLUDED.position, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
